'''Ramsey Lanclo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Chicanery]]'', and owned the modified [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] [[XDL-67]]. Often shipping legitimate cargo, such as [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] and [[prefab shelter]]s, he occasionally turned to illicit goods when he was low on [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. At one such time, whilst carrying a cargo of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]], he was boarded by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Customs]] [[Imperial Customs Frigate|frigate]]. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by a human female named [[Hewat]], attached to the ''Chicanery'' via a boarding tube, disgorging Hewet and two accompanying [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Security guard/Legends|guards]]. XDL-67 emitted a baritone moan, summoning Lanclo's pet [[marsupial]] [[keon]] to the cockpit before the Imperials disembarked from the tube. Using the keon as a distraction from his cargo, the droid and Lanclo convinced Hewet to "confiscate" the animal, so Lanclo could avoid making port simply to purchase a permit for the marsupial. Hewet took the animal, to give to her daughter [[Kora]] on [[Yityl]].<ref name="CFTD" />
